parameters.query: SELECT t.name AS tname, t.logo_key AS tlogo, t.sport, m.id, m.status, m.label, m.live, eh.id AS hid, th.name AS hname, th.short_name AS hshort, th.logo_key AS hlogo, ea.id AS aid, ta.name AS aname, ta.short_name AS ashort, ta.logo_key AS alogo FROM tournaments t JOIN tournament_matches m ON m.tournament_id = t.id LEFT JOIN tournament_entries eh ON eh.id = m.home_entry_id LEFT JOIN teams th ON th.id = eh.team_id LEFT JOIN tournament_entries ea ON ea.id = m.away_entry_id LEFT JOIN teams ta ON ta.id = ea.team_id WHERE t.code = $1 AND t.status <> 'DRAFT' AND m.live IS NOT NULL AND (($2 = 0 AND m.status IN ('LIVE', 'COMPLETED')) OR m.id = $2) ORDER BY (m.status = 'LIVE') DESC, m.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
